scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names contracts,chess,database,api,web "tsc -b packages/contracts --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "tsc -b packages/chess --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "tsc -b packages/database --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "node --watch --watch-preserve-output --conditions=development --import tsx apps/api/src/server.ts" "vite apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @neurochess/api && npm run build --workspace @neurochess/web
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web "npm run start --workspace @neurochess/api" "npm run preview --workspace @neurochess/web"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:architecture
scripts.test:architecture: depcruise --config dependency-cruiser.config.mjs apps packages && node scripts/check-architecture-fixture.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.build:deployment:test: docker build -f deploy/Dockerfile --target api --build-arg VITE_API_BASE_URL=https://localhost:8444 -t neurochess-api:p5-10 . && docker build -f deploy/Dockerfile --target web --build-arg VITE_API_BASE_URL=https://localhost:8444 -t neurochess-web:p5-10 .
scripts.auth:generate: auth generate --config apps/api/auth-schema.config.ts --adapter drizzle --dialect pg --output packages/database/src/schema/auth.ts --yes
